issue.title: Project metadata audit still expects the pre-split lumberjack refresh site
issue.description: Commit 97a2f821c2 moved _run_tick into src/sase/axe/_lumberjack_tick.py, but tests/_project_display_presentation_audit_metadata.py still scans and allowlists src/sase/axe/lumberjack.py. Update both the audited file inventory and expected loader tuple to follow the real refresh_project_display_snapshot call, retaining the boundary assertion. Recorded check 213943eade02826f091c8cae17601735 and an unmodified-HEAD targeted rerun both fail with the old tuple missing and no unexpected loader calls.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The recorded check and an isolated unmodified-HEAD rerun fail identically. The missing AST location is deterministic: production moved to _lumberjack_tick.py while the audit still names lumberjack.py. Earlier tool triage labeled it FLAKY, but this independent reproduction identifies a stale source-path expectation.

issue.creation_reason: Approved import-cycle verification exposed a deterministic existing contract-test failure, reproduced on unmodified HEAD; the obsolete audit path needs a focused repair.
